dataset_summary.label_audit_verdict: CRITICAL AUDIT FINDING: 100% of negative training samples (575 images) were derived heuristically from folder classifications (potholes, cracks, broken_edges, etc.) rather than independent physical ground-truth inspection. They must not be described as human-verified negatives.

license_governance.blocker_reason: The IRDID dataset repository lacks an explicit OSI-compliant open-source license file (e.g. MIT, Apache 2.0, CC-BY). While permitted for academic research and assistive municipal prototyping, autonomous production enforcement is strictly BLOCKED until formal licensing terms are established.

abstention_policy.rule: If model predicted probability p falls within [0.35, 0.65], or confidence < 0.65, the system MUST NOT assign VISIBLE_WATERLOGGING or NO_VISIBLE_WATERLOGGING. The result is classified as INDETERMINATE_HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED and routed to the municipal review queue.

failure_modes.title: Wet Asphalt Without Standing Water
failure_modes.description: Rain-darkened asphalt with sheen but no standing water causes high activations due to dark specular texture.
failure_modes.mitigation: Abstention policy active. Low depth confidence flags image for municipal officer inspection.

failure_modes.title: Sunlight & Windshield Specular Reflections
failure_modes.description: Bright specular highlights from wet road surfaces or vehicle windshields trigger false water reflection features.
failure_modes.mitigation: Requires municipal officer review. Edge gradients distinguish reflections from pooled water boundaries.

failure_modes.title: Urban Flyover & Tree Canopy Shadows
failure_modes.description: High-contrast geometric building or flyover shadows mimic dark water patches in low-resolution 256x256 imagery.
failure_modes.mitigation: Assisted human review; officer examines context.

failure_modes.title: Potholes Containing Water vs Flooded Carriageway
failure_modes.description: CRITICAL FINDING: In IRDID, images categorized in 'potholes/' frequently contain rainwater inside the pothole. Because all pothole images were treated as negative (NO_VISIBLE_WATERLOGGING), the model is penalized when detecting water inside potholes, or falsely flags localized potholes as general road waterlogging.
failure_modes.mitigation: Reclassify localized puddle/pothole water as non-flooded road condition during human review.

failure_modes.title: Night Scenes & Low-Light Headlight Glare
failure_modes.description: Low contrast asphalt at night with localized headlight blooming severely degrades feature discriminability.
failure_modes.mitigation: Model abstains on low-illumination night frames; status marked INDETERMINATE_HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.

failure_modes.title: Heavy Rainfall & Droplets on Dashcam Glass
failure_modes.description: Raindrops on the vehicle windshield in front of dashcam lens refract light and distort road surface classification.
failure_modes.mitigation: Confidence threshold filtering; require stationary or clear citizen photo where feasible.

failure_modes.title: Low-Quality Compressed Mobile Citizen Photos
failure_modes.description: Motion blur, digital zoom compression artifacts, and poor framing from moving auto-rickshaws.
failure_modes.mitigation: Size and resolution verification; images below quality thresholds rejected by ingestion validator.

failure_modes.title: Unpaved Rural Roads & Construction Slurry
failure_modes.description: Muddy tracks, slurry pits, or construction detours present wet soil textures absent in urban tarmac training.
failure_modes.mitigation: Spatial cross-referencing with Delhi municipal road network layer.

failure_modes.title: Excavation Trenches & Barricaded Construction
failure_modes.description: Construction zones contain wet concrete washouts and slurry trenches labeled as road damage.
failure_modes.mitigation: Treated strictly as assistive evidence; never autonomous dispatch.

failure_modes.title: Open Manholes & Storm Drain Gaps
failure_modes.description: Open manhole voids can be dark circular features mistaken for localized water ponding.
failure_modes.mitigation: Flagged as high-severity hazard requiring immediate field barrier.
